title: Access Dental Management breach exposes health and SSN data of 341,049 people
date_note: Becker's Dental (16 Nov) dates the Vermont filing 12 Nov and the Texas filing 13 Nov; SecurityWeek (17 Nov) reported them. The intrusion happened between May 1 and May 4, 2026, and was discovered on May 5.
summary: Texas-based dental services provider Access Dental Management says attackers accessed its network between May 1 and 4 and viewed or copied names, addresses, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, medical and health insurance information. SecurityWeek says 341,049 people were affected (Texas and Vermont filings); the total could reportedly surpass 455,000. The WorldLeaks ransomware group claimed the intrusion on June 5.
plain: A dental group in Texas says attackers accessed its network and viewed or copied patients' personal, medical and insurance details, including Social Security numbers, for 341,049 people.
exec: Health-data breach at a private-equity-backed dental group affecting 341,049 people, including Social Security numbers.
action: If you are an Access Dental Management patient, watch for its written notification letter and stay vigilant against identity theft and fraud, as ADM advises.
impact: Personal, medical and insurance data of 341,049 people, per SecurityWeek.

validation.note: SecurityWeek report citing ADM's notice and filings with the Texas and Vermont attorneys general. Follow-up 2026-11-21T11:10:30Z: Becker's Dental (read) relays Claim Depot for the ransomware and data types and gives the filing dates, so it is not independent for the core facts; still single-source.
